Description: Participants listened to a looping audio consisting of one melodic phrase followed by six lyrical phrases, repeated three times.
Instructions: Close your eyes and create mental images inspired by the content of each lyrical phrase. Focus on visualizing each sentence as vividly as possible.
StimulusDescription: The audio is a 2-minute and 13-second composition with a repeating structure: one melodic introduction followed by six lyrical phrases, looped three times.
CognitiveDescription: Mental imagery triggered by lyrical musical content.
CognitiveBehavioralInstructions: Stay still, keep your eyes closed, and visualize the meaning or narrative of each phrase in your mind.
